slides.title: Key questions

paragraphs.text: Key questions
Should Onsoo enter the US in 2027, and by which route, to build toward $40M of US revenue by 2030 within the board's cash, payback and margin limits?
Is US K-beauty skincare large, growing and reachable for Onsoo?
Does an Amazon-led launch meet the board's ambition, cash cap, payback and margin floor?
Does a 600-door retail-led launch meet the board's limits, and are its inputs realistic?
Is a Japan scale-up a better use of the one launch slot in 2027?
How should Onsoo launch, and which gates protect the board's limits?
Decision maker
Success criteria
Timing
Out of scope
CEO Park Ji-won and the board

Cumulative US cash need of no more than $18M through 2030; US cash flow back to zero by the end of 2030; Group operating margin at or above 8% in every year; On the way to $40M of US revenue by 2030; Only one major new-market launch in 2027
Board meeting, March 2027
Makeup and hair care; DTC-led and mass-retail-led routes (not modeled); Markets other than the US and Japan; Price changes

slides.title: Executive summary

paragraphs.text: Executive summary
Enter the US in 2027 through Amazon: the only route that builds toward $40M within the board's limits, if ad cost holds near 28%
The US is worth entering: K-beauty skincare is growing fast, led by Amazon
–	K-beauty grew 89% since 2021, against 22% for US facial skincare
The Amazon route fits the cash cap and margin floor; its payback hinges on ad cost
–	Cash low point is $1.9M against an $18M cap; group margin stays above 9%
–	It pays back by 2030 only below 28.6% ad cost; scaling brands pay 32%
The retail route breaks the board's limits even on its own, optimistic inputs
–	Option B needs $20.8M of cash by 2030 and cuts group margin to 4.5%
A Japan scale-up earns more cash to 2030, but is too small to replace the US
–	It adds $7.0M of revenue by 2030 in a market growing about 1.5% a year
Launch on Amazon in 2027 under four gates; add retail only above 20% awareness
–	Keep ad cost at or below 28%, and lower that ceiling if the duty rises
–	Reset $40M as a post-2030 goal; Option A reaches $26.4M in 2030
